summary: Plan P07 carries the rank-count outputs (loss ratios 100/539 and 101/539, positive deficit and s<W m, the 1-2^-50 exponent with its two conditions), the final shear step of one interchange per one of Pi, the O(V) lower-triangular shear cost, and the per-vector tensored kernel child count s_c. It mostly states results of the six lemmas without their sub-derivations: no scalar-network proof, label residual table, side-edge computation, telescoping, orthonormal-basis argument, phase endpoint analysis, exact eta values, elimination proof, prime choice, or any of the guard-width constants, depth recurrence, unrolling, bit reservation and row-sum argument. 6 of 26 present.
